method: Deterministic arithmetic on strictly parsed numbers: water weight is converted to grams (1 oz = 28.349523125 g) and treated as millilitres at 1 g/ml. Wax = volume x density; fragrance = wax x load / 100, added on top of the wax; per-container figures multiply by the container count. Density presets are typical supplier values (soy 0.86, paraffin 0.90, coconut-soy 0.90, beeswax 0.96 g/ml) and can be overridden. No allowance is made for shrinkage, wax left in the pouring pot, wick volume or topping up after the first burn.
